entries.title: Hosea 7:1
segments:
Ephraim--Samaria; Ephraim is often put for the kingdom of the ten tribes, because Samaria, the royal city, lay in the tribe of Ephraim. 
 
vv 1-10. 
 
The history of the kingdom of Israel furnishes a true illustration of the tendency and effects of apostasy from God.  It began by substituting for the worship of Jehovah that of the golden calves; it ended in a universal corruption of morals, extending alike to rulers and subjects; filling the land with drunkenness, adultery, fraud, violence, murder, sedition, and anarchy, and making it an easy prey to its enemies.

entries.title: Hosea 7:4
segments: As an oven heated; here, and in

, the hearts of the people, inflamed with sinful passions, are compared to burning ovens. 
 
  From raising; or, "from stirring up;" that is, the fire. 
 
  Until it be leavened; when he kindles the oven into a fierce heat. See note on

entries.title: Hosea 7:5
segments: The day of our king; probably his birthday.

entries.title: Hosea 7:6
segments:
Made ready their heart; applied themselves to their wicked plots. 
 
  Lie in wait; to destroy their judges and kings.
Their baker--a flaming fire; here, and in

, we should probably understand the figure thus: the baker, having kneaded his dough, leaves in the oven a smothered fire, sufficient to keep it warm through the night, while it is rising, and then rests till morning, when he kindles it into a blazing fire for the purpose of baking.  So the impure and murderous passions of the people smoulder in their hearts till a fit occasion arrives, when they blaze forth like a heated oven.

entries.title: Hosea 7:7
segments: Judges--kings; the history of the kingdom of Israel in its later years, when one royal house was murdered to make way for another, is the best commentary on this verse.

entries.title: Hosea 7:8
segments: Mixed himself among the people; the people are the heathen nations. Compare

. 
 
  A cake; in the original, a cake baked in the embers. 
 
  Not turned; burned on one side and raw on the other, and hence worthless.

entries.title: Hosea 7:9
segments: Gray hairs; a sign that the nation was in its old age, and near its end.

entries.title: Hosea 7:11
segments: Call to Egypt--go to Assyria; for help, instead of to Jehovah. Menahem made a covenant with Assyria,

; and Hoshea sought aid from Egypt against the king of Assyria at the very time he was in covenant with him.  2Ki 17.4  It is probable that his predecessors also sought the alliance of Egypt against their enemies. 
 
vv 11-16. 
 
They who in times of calamity persevere in sin and seek help from men instead of God, only bring upon themselves deeper ruin, and have derision from those to whom they looked for salvation.

entries.title: Hosea 7:12
segments: As their congregation hath heard; namely, from the law of Moses and the messages of the prophets.

entries.title: Hosea 7:14
segments:
Howled upon their beds; for the failure of corn and wine. 
 
  For corn and wine; to supplicate God for it.  They come with insincere and rebellious hearts.

entries.title: Hosea 7:16
segments:
A deceitful bow; that sends the arrow aside from the mark. 
 
  The rage of their tongue; against God and his prophets. 
 
  This shall be their derision; the fall of their princes. 
 
  In the land of Egypt; they looked to Egypt for help against their enemies, but there they shall have derision instead of help.
